mapper.select: SELECT REFUND_ID, ORDER_ID, USER_ID, AMOUNT, REASON, STATUS, ADMIN_USER_ID, ADMIN_NOTE, REQUESTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT, PG_CANCELLATION_ID, PROCESSED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM REFUNDS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY REFUND_ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT R.REFUND_ID, R.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_CODE, R.USER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS USER_NICKNAME, R.AMOUNT, R.REASON, R.STATUS, R.ADMIN_USER_ID, A.NICKNAME AS ADMIN_NICKNAME, R.ADMIN_NOTE, R.REQUESTED_AT, R.PROCESSED_AT, R.COMPLETED_AT FROM REFUNDS R JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = R.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS A ON A.USER_ID = R.ADMIN_USER_ID WHERE R.REFUND_ID = #{refundId}

SELECT R.REFUND_ID, R.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_CODE, R.USER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS USER_NICKNAME, R.AMOUNT, R.REASON, R.STATUS, R.ADMIN_USER_ID, A.NICKNAME AS ADMIN_NICKNAME, R.ADMIN_NOTE, R.REQUESTED_AT, R.PROCESSED_AT, R.COMPLETED_AT FROM REFUNDS R JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = R.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS A ON A.USER_ID = R.ADMIN_USER_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.REQUESTED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REFUNDS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE REFUNDS SET STATUS = #{status}, ADMIN_USER_ID = #{adminUserId}, ADMIN_NOTE = #{adminNote}, PG_CANCELLATION_ID = #{pgCancellationId}, PROCESSED_AT = NOW(), COMPLETED_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('APPROVED','COMPLETED','REJECTED') THEN NOW() ELSE COMPLETED_AT END WHERE REFUND_ID = #{refundId}
